## Android and iOS (Platform; Japan)

- https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.square_enix.android_googleplay.ffgm -- the Android row -- accessed 2026-10-20 (the id and the iOS link come from the official site's capture of 2015-11-17, https://web.archive.org/web/20151117042801/http://www.jp.square-enix.com/FFGM/, found by the user)
  - The store page is gone (404); the row links the last capture, 2019-08-24 (version 2.1.12, updated 2019-02-22, 500,000+ installs): https://web.archive.org/web/20190824064747/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.square_enix.android_googleplay.ffgm
  - Earlier capture of 2015-12-08 (page text pasted by user): version 1.1.3, updated 2015-11-19, 13,787 ratings (3.6 stars), 100,000 to 500,000 installs, Android 4.0 or later, Role Playing, in-app purchases
- https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id1011102761 -- the iOS row -- accessed 2026-10-20
  - Gone (404); the row links the last capture, 2019-08-22 (version 2.1.12 of 2019-02-21, 4.2 stars from 2,528 ratings): https://web.archive.org/web/20190822052100/https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id1011102761
  - Capture of 2016-05-13 (page text pasted by user): an online RPG for smartphones in the Vana'diel world, with a custom character, stamina-free quests, one-touch battles, co-op play and emote communication; version 1.4.0 added five-person battles, ability inheritance, cast and recast, a gift feature and a selectable battle command UI; seller SQUARE ENIX INC; reviews complain of bugs and a gem system
  - The Wayback captures of the official site, https://www.jp.square-enix.com/FFGM/, carry the store links in the 2015-11-17 capture (the 2015-03-19 capture had none)

- The official site is the entry's `profileUrl` (user, 2026-10-20), the capture that links the store pages while the game was live: https://web.archive.org/web/20151117042801/http://www.jp.square-enix.com/FFGM/
